summary: Brownie's Marine Group filed an 8-K reporting its wholly-owned subsidiary Live Blue's acquisition of substantially all assets of Sunrise Paddleboards LLC via an Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 1, 2026. Consideration: 42,000,000 shares of Brownie's common stock at $0.0044/share (~$185K), based on the June 30 closing price. The shares were issued privately under Section 4(a)(2). No premium, board recommendation, or advisors were stated. The transaction closed simultaneously. Watch for shareholder dilution and OTC market reaction.
